// This file is used only by the Go build overlay in TestBluetoothCLI.
// It replaces OS radio I/O with ordered packets over a Unix socket. Production
// builds neither compile this file nor recognize ARC_TEST_BLE_SOCKET.
package ble

import (
 "context"
 "encoding/binary"
 "io"
 "net"
 "os"
 "time"
)

type testRadio struct { net.Conn; stop func()bool }
func(r *testRadio)Close()error{r.stop();return r.Conn.Close()}
// payload is a typical negotiated size, so the CLI test sends large packets.
func(r *testRadio)payload()int{return 182}
func(r *testRadio)write(ctx context.Context,b []byte)error{
 deadline,_:=ctx.Deadline();_ = r.SetWriteDeadline(deadline)
 data:=make([]byte,len(b)+2);binary.BigEndian.PutUint16(data,uint16(len(b)));copy(data[2:],b)
 for len(data)>0 {n,err:=r.Write(data);if err!=nil{return err};data=data[n:]};return nil
}
func(r *testRadio)read(ctx context.Context)([]byte,error){
 deadline,_:=ctx.Deadline();_ = r.SetReadDeadline(deadline)
 header:=make([]byte,2);if _,err:=io.ReadFull(r,header);err!=nil{return nil,err}
 b:=make([]byte,int(binary.BigEndian.Uint16(header)));_,err:=io.ReadFull(r,b);return b,err
}
func OpenDirect(ctx context.Context,c DirectConfig)(*Direct,error){
 setup,cancel:=context.WithTimeout(ctx,operationTimeout);defer cancel()
 path:=os.Getenv("ARC_TEST_BLE_SOCKET")
 var conn net.Conn
 var err error
 if c.Address=="" {
 var listener net.Listener
 listener,err=net.Listen("unix",path)
 if err!=nil{return nil,err}
 stop:=context.AfterFunc(setup,func(){_ = listener.Close()})
 conn,err=listener.Accept();stop();_ = listener.Close()
 }else{
 for setup.Err()==nil {
 conn,err=(&net.Dialer{}).DialContext(setup,"unix",path)
 if err==nil{break}
 select{case <-setup.Done():return nil,setup.Err();case <-time.After(10*time.Millisecond):}
 }
 }
 if err!=nil{return nil,err}
 r:=&testRadio{Conn:conn};r.stop=context.AfterFunc(ctx,func(){_ = conn.Close()})
 secure,err:=authenticate(setup,r,c,c.Address!="")
 if err!=nil{r.Close();return nil,err}
 return newDirect(ctx,secure,c),nil
}

func directSupported()error{return nil}
